current_task_corrections.correction: Change financial_summary statistics parameter from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report median, p90, and p99 percentiles alongside sums and means, providing a complete picture of claim amount distributions which are typically skewed.

Change write_report show_denominators parameter from false to true to display all rates as 'numerator / denominator = rate' in the report, enabling readers to verify calculations and understand metric scope.
Setting write_report show_denominators to true will automatically generate the required denominator format, ensuring rates display as 'numerator / denominator = rate' in the report.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When summarizing financial amounts in claims analysis, always report quantile statistics (median, p90, p99) in addition to sums and means to capture the true distribution shape, especially important for skewed distributions.

Display all rates and ratios explicitly as 'numerator / denominator = rate' in claims analysis reports to ensure transparency and enable readers to verify calculations and understand the exact scope of each metric.
